description: Calculate the 36-guna Ashtakoota marriage compatibility score between two people from their birth details. The calculation is Moon-based, so birth time is optional; supplying it is more accurate because the Moon moves about 13 degrees a day.

boy.description: First person: birth date, optional time, latitude and longitude.

girl.description: Second person: birth date, optional time, latitude and longitude.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.
